description: This file contains macro definitions, version constants, class declarations, and utility functions for the pybind11 library's internal 'common' header, used for C++/Python bindings. It includes version checks, exception classes, type traits, and macro utilities for module creation and error handling.

classes.name: builtin_exception
classes.description: Base class for Python exceptions mapped in C++, allowing setting Python error states from C++.

classes.name: stop_iteration
classes.description: Exception class for Python StopIteration error.

classes.name: cast_error
classes.description: Exception class for casting errors in pybind11.

classes.name: reference_cast_error
classes.description: Internal exception class for reference cast errors.

classes.name: error_scope
classes.description: RAII class that saves and restores Python error state within a scope.

classes.name: overload_cast_impl
classes.description: Helper template for resolving overloaded functions.

methods.name: ssize_t_cast
methods.description: Casts an integer type to ssize_t with static_assert for safety.

methods.name: pybind11_fail
methods.description: Raises a runtime_error with a reason, used for fatal errors.

methods.name: get_fully_qualified_tp_name
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of a PyTypeObject.

methods.name: try_get_shared_from_this
methods.description: Attempts to get a shared_ptr from an enable_shared_from_this object, with fallback.
